I added `GET /api/v1/items/stats`. I haven't run the tests or the app, as you asked, so none of it has been run.

The response is `{"count": n, "newest_title": str | null}`. A regular user gets their own items. A superuser gets the numbers across all items.

- **`backend/app/models.py`**: new `ItemsStats` response schema.
- **`backend/app/crud.py`**: new `get_items_stats(*, session, owner_id=None)`. It counts items and picks the newest title, ordered by `created_at` and then `id` so ties are deterministic. With `owner_id=None` it covers all items.
- **`backend/app/api/routes/items.py`**: new `read_items_stats` handler that calls the crud function. The route is declared before `/{id}`, otherwise `stats` would be parsed as a UUID and return 422. It makes no direct session calls, which follows the crud-layer rule in `CLAUDE.md`.
